IDI FORMULATION & ACCURACY FRAMEWORK
CORE FORMULA
IDI(t) = 1 − Σ [wᵢ* · φᵢ(t)]
wᵢ* = redistributed weight = original wᵢ / Σ available weights
PARAMETER WEIGHTS
PARAMETERWEIGHTDIRECTIONINSTRUMENT
Flow Rate (Q)0.30↓ with degradationFlow meter
Pressure (P)0.30↓ with degradationPressure gauge
Current (I)0.25↑ with degradationClamp meter
Temperature (T)0.15↑ with degradationIR thermometer
ARIMA(2,1,0) MODEL
Δy[t] = φ₁·Δy[t−1] + φ₂·Δy[t−2] + ε[t]
• d=1 differencing removes trend non-stationarity in the IDI series
• AR coefficients φ₁, φ₂ estimated via Yule-Walker equations from historical IDI data
• 95% CI: ±1.96σ√h, where h = forecast horizon, σ = residual standard deviation
• Stability constraint: |φ₁|+|φ₂| ≤ 0.95 enforced for valid long-range projections
ECONOMICS ENGINE
Energy waste = P_rated × η_loss(IDI) × hours × tariff (₦)
Maint escalation = C_base × [(1+r)^D − 1], r scales with IDI severity
Downtime risk = P(failure|IDI) × MTTR × prod_rate × ore_price
Total exposure = 30-day sum of all three components
FAULT SIGNATURE MATRIX
FAULTφQφPφIφTCOMPONENT
Impeller Wear↓↓↓→↑Impeller
Seal Leakage↓↓↓↓↓→Mechanical Seal
Bearing Failure→→↑↑↑Bearings
